significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) law: residual-stream projection onto a "monotonic 'harm-magnitude' scalar" tracks annotated severity while remaining comparatively invariant when jailbreaks change refusal behavior. This establishes both a graded representational phenomenon and a non-causal mechanistic account of jailbreak bypass, constraining expected activations and detection performance across severity tiers and attacks rather than merely identifying another refusal direction; this matters against the refusal-centric account exemplified by Arditi et al., "Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction" (NeurIPS 2024). Verified false and verified true are distinguishable, although the composite negative branch would only rule out a generally monotonic, jailbreak-preserved scalar—not identify whether severity encoding or invariance failed—so it is less informative than the positive branch. The topic-substitution check lowers no credit: replacing this graded invariant relation with generic mechanistic LLM safety would not justify the score, whereas the specific ordering and invariance are substantially sharper than the topic's obvious refusal-probe hypothesis.

reach.justification: The named handles are a "lightweight internal safety monitor that reads the graded axis" and a score that enables "calibrated responses (soft warnings vs hard refusals)"; these are ex ante because they can flag or gate a request before a harmful answer is released, rather than merely explain a jailbreak afterward. After per-model re-extraction, the substantive prediction survives as a relation—severity should remain monotonic and the projection should stay high when refusal is bypassed—so the conclusion offers more than a procedure for rediscovering an unconstrained direction. The hypothesis is phrased broadly for safety-aligned LLMs and would be usable by model auditors and deployment gatekeepers, although its own limitation to "open-weight mid-size models" weakens confidence that the operational handle travels unchanged to frontier systems or obfuscated inputs. The topic-substitution check passes: generic interpretability-based safety supplies neither this graded score nor its claimed jailbreak invariance and therefore would not independently earn this reach score.
